Hi Rama,
I hope you're doing well. I wanted to reach out regarding your stay at Unit 107, Elite U.
Our records show that your booking ended on July 4th, and as of today (July 5th), there is no active reservation on file for your continued stay.
Could you please let us know your plans as soon as possible? If you'd like to extend your stay, we're happy to check availability and arrange a new booking for you. Otherwise, we kindly ask that you complete checkout and vacate the unit at your earliest convenience today.
Please reach out to us directly so we can resolve this smoothly. Thank you for your understanding, and we look forward to hearing from you soon.
